_comment: Seal source of truth (Day 10). README results table and the resume MUST render from this file; regenerate everything with the commands in each entry. Tree: ros2_tunnel_explorer bline-merge-20260908; D-line linear_mpc_controller cloud-exploration-20260908.

coverage_chain.claim: segment ledger stable (+/-1.5%); grid coverage is alignment-sensitive; report RANGE + both denominators; executor ledger != absolute coverage.

mpc_matrix.claim: 3 geometry x 2 v_min x 2 projection modes; failure axis = geometry & v_min, not projection implementation (10/12 cells identical across modes); cap geometry passes at both v_min -> no maneuver-generation layer needed; nocap needs negative velocity; backward needs true reversing.
mpc_matrix.real_path_audit: 16/250 plan reference points exceed omega_max=2.0 on the raw u9 plan; fix rule v <= omega_max/|kappa| implemented (D-line 85276e3).

b6b_nav2_plugin.claims: sandbox gates stage1 4/4, 2a 7/7, 2b 8/8; terminal-clamp negative control intact 1.98 m vs clamp-disabled 13.14-13.16 m (delta 11.18 m); NOT wired into the coverage chain; NO hard-real-time claim.

boundaries: No hard real-time statement is authorized.
Executor plans internally via C++ ScanlinePlanner; python cleaning_mode is the reproducibility-canonical planner (geometry-equivalent on the rect room only).
Chain controller = RotationShim + DWB; the linear-MPC plugin is a separate sandbox-verified deliverable.
U9-era entrance-hysteresis A/B numbers (1/5, 590 s, -45% goals) are NOT reproducible from any committed tree and are excluded from README and resume.
